#2026 data
```{r}
library(googlesheets4)
library(tidyverse)
fish = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1T3TNqTVI4zFGS-up--IIOSRfn0fsBx5Dj7zEeDEAiCQ/edit?gid=1772713005#gid=1772713005', sheet = 1)
ki = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1T3TNqTVI4zFGS-up--IIOSRfn0fsBx5Dj7zEeDEAiCQ/edit?gid=1772713005#gid=1772713005', sheet = 2)
cover = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1T3TNqTVI4zFGS-up--IIOSRfn0fsBx5Dj7zEeDEAiCQ/edit?gid=1772713005#gid=1772713005', sheet = 3)
koa = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1T3TNqTVI4zFGS-up--IIOSRfn0fsBx5Dj7zEeDEAiCQ/edit?gid=1772713005#gid=1772713005', sheet = 4)

fish <- fish %>%
  rename(plot_type = arkev_type)

ki <- ki %>%
  rename(plot_type = arkev_type)

cover <- cover %>%
  rename(plot_type = arkev_type)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)

clean_survey_metadata <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(date),
      site = str_to_lower(str_trim(site)),
      site = str_replace_all(site, " ", "_"),
      plot_type = str_to_lower(str_trim(plot_type)),
      arkev_unit = str_trim(arkev_unit)
    )
}

fish  <- clean_survey_metadata(fish)
ki    <- clean_survey_metadata(ki)
cover <- clean_survey_metadata(cover)
```

```{r}
survey_key <- c("date", "site", "plot_type", "arkev_unit")

# Check duplicate survey keys
fish %>%
  count(across(all_of(survey_key))) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_with_multiple_rows = sum(n > 1),
    max_rows_per_survey = max(n)
  )

ki %>%
  count(across(all_of(survey_key))) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

cover %>%
  count(across(all_of(survey_key))) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
```

```{r}
bind_rows(
  ki %>%
    transmute(
      dataset = "Kelp, grazers, invertebrates",
      date = as.Date(date),
      site,
      plot_type
    ),

  cover %>%
    transmute(
      dataset = "Biological cover",
      date = as.Date(date),
      site,
      plot_type
    )
) %>%
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(date)) %>%
  group_by(dataset, year, site, plot_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    first_date = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_date = max(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(dataset, year, site, plot_type)
```

```{r}
survey_key <- c("date", "site", "plot_type", "arkev_unit")

ki_surveys <- ki %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(survey_key)))

cover_surveys <- cover %>%
  distinct(across(all_of(survey_key)))

tibble(
  check = c(
    "KI total rows",
    "KI unique surveys",
    "Cover total rows",
    "Cover unique surveys",
    "KI surveys missing from cover",
    "Cover surveys missing from KI"
  ),
  n = c(
    nrow(ki),
    nrow(ki_surveys),
    nrow(cover),
    nrow(cover_surveys),
    nrow(anti_join(ki_surveys, cover_surveys, by = survey_key)),
    nrow(anti_join(cover_surveys, ki_surveys, by = survey_key))
  )
)
```

```{r}
fish_surveys <- fish %>%
```

```{r}
grazers <- c( "HALRUF", "HALKAM", "purple_urchins_<2cm","purple_urchins_>2cm","red_urchins","tegula")

kelp <- c("NERA", "NERJ", "LAMR", "LAMSET", "PTECAL", "DESSPP", "ALAMAR", "COSCOS", "LAMSTUMP", "DICSPP","DICTYOTALES")

inverts <- c("PATMIN",  "DERIMB",  "PISOCH",  "PISBRE",  "PISGIG",  "CANCERSPP",  "PUGPRO",  "PYCHEL")

setdiff(
  c(grazers, kelp, inverts),
  names(ki)
)
```

```{r}
ki = ki %>%
  mutate(
    survey_id = paste(
      date,
      site,
      plot_type,
      arkev_unit,
      sep = "_"
    ))

fish <- fish %>%
  mutate(
    survey_id = paste(
      date, site, plot_type, arkev_unit,
      sep = "_"
    )
  )

cover <- cover %>%
  mutate(
    survey_id = paste(
      date, site, plot_type, arkev_unit,
      sep = "_"
    )
  )

# Verify all three datasets
sapply(
  list(ki = ki, fish = fish, cover = cover),
  function(x) c(
    rows = nrow(x),
    unique_ids = n_distinct(x$survey_id)
  )
)
```


#2025 data
```{r}
surveys_2025 = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1i3KlFK9ZlCHW7vNudpcN0kkriUDP4IahfxkR6CVGroQ/edit?gid=0#gid=0')

surveys_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    site = str_to_lower(str_trim(site)),
    site = str_replace_all(site, " ", "_"),
    ARKEV_type = str_to_lower(str_trim(plot_type)),
    ARKEV_unit = str_trim(ARKEV_unit),
    data_type = str_to_lower(str_trim(data_type)),
    species_code = str_to_upper(str_trim(species_code))
    )

survey_key_2025 <- c(
  "year",
  "date",
  "site",
  "ARKEV_type",
  "ARKEV_unit"
)

# Check the structure of the 2025 data
dim(surveys_2025)

names(surveys_2025)

surveys_2025 %>%
  count(data_type, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  rename(
    arkev_unit = ARKEV_unit
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    site = str_to_lower(str_trim(site)),
    site = str_replace_all(site, " ", "_"),

    plot_type = str_to_lower(str_trim(plot_type)),
    arkev_unit = str_trim(as.character(arkev_unit)),

    data_type = str_to_lower(str_trim(data_type)),
    species_code = str_to_upper(str_trim(species_code))
  )

# Check the cleaned metadata
surveys_2025 %>%
  distinct(site, plot_type) %>%
  arrange(site, plot_type)
```

```{r}
surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    year = 2025,
    date = as.Date(
      paste(year, month, day, sep = "-")
    ),
    survey_id = paste(
      date,
      site,
      plot_type,
      arkev_unit,
      sep = "_"
    )
  )

surveys_2025 %>%
  summarise(
    n_records = n(),
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    n_dates = n_distinct(date),
    first_date = min(date),
    last_date = max(date),
    n_missing_dates = sum(is.na(date))
  )
```

```{r}
surveys_2025 %>%
  count(
    data_type,
    species_code,
    sort = TRUE
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%

surveys_2025 %>%

  )
```

```{r}
surveys_2025 %>%

  ) %>%

```

```{r}
surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(
```

```{r}
kelp_surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(data_type == "kelp") %>%
  group_by(survey_id) %>%
  filter(!any(is.na(count_num))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(
    survey_id,
    year,
    date,
    site,
    plot_type,
    arkev_unit
  )

# Check how many kelp surveys are retained
tibble(
  total_kelp_surveys = surveys_2025 %>%
    filter(data_type == "kelp") %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(survey_id)) %>%
    pull(n),

  complete_kelp_surveys = nrow(kelp_surveys_2025)
)
```

```{r}
kelp_obs_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(
    data_type == "kelp",
    species_code != "NO_KELP"
  ) %>%
  semi_join(
    kelp_surveys_2025,
    by = "survey_id"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    survey_id,
    species_code
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(count_num),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check the resulting observations
kelp_obs_2025 %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys_with_kelp = n_distinct(survey_id),
    n_species = n_distinct(species_code),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(abundance))
  )
```

```{r}
kelp_2025_wide <- kelp_surveys_2025 %>%
  left_join(
    kelp_obs_2025 %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = species_code,
        values_from = abundance,
        values_fill = 0
      ),
    by = "survey_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      -c(
        survey_id, year, date, site,
        plot_type, arkev_unit
      ),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    survey_id, year, date, site,
    plot_type, arkev_unit,
    everything()
  )

# Check the completed kelp dataset
kelp_2025_wide %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_all_zero = sum(
      rowSums(
        select(
          .,
          -survey_id, -year, -date,
          -site, -plot_type, -arkev_unit
        )
      ) == 0
    ),
    n_missing = sum(
      is.na(
        select(
          .,
          -survey_id, -year, -date,
          -site, -plot_type, -arkev_unit
        )
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Correct the confirmed red urchin zero
surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    count_num = if_else(
      date == as.Date("2025-10-06") &
        site == "big_river" &
        plot_type == "arkev" &
        arkev_unit == "1C" &
        data_type == "urchins" &
        species_code == "MESFRA",
      0,
      count_num
    )
  )

# Rebuild the list of completed grazer surveys
grazer_surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(data_type %in% c("urchins", "tegula")) %>%
  group_by(survey_id) %>%
  filter(!any(is.na(count_num))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(
    survey_id, year, date, site,
    plot_type, arkev_unit
  ) %>%
  semi_join(
    invert_surveys_2025,
    by = "survey_id"
  )

# Verify
tibble(
  complete_grazer_surveys = nrow(grazer_surveys_2025),
  surveys_missing_invert_data = nrow(
    anti_join(
      grazer_surveys_2025,
      invert_surveys_2025,
      by = "survey_id"
    )
  )
)
```


```{r}
surveys_2025 %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    n_date = n_distinct(date),
    n_sites = n_distinct(site),
    n_plot_types = n_distinct(plot_type),
    n_units = n_distinct(arkev_unit)
  )

surveys_2025 %>%
  count(
    survey_id,
    date,
    site,
    plot_type,
    arkev_unit
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  head(20)
```

```{r}
grazer_obs_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(
    data_type %in% c("urchins", "tegula")
  ) %>%
  semi_join(
    grazer_surveys_2025,
    by = "survey_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = case_when(
      species_code == "STRPUR" & size_cm == "<2cm" ~ "purple_urchins_<2cm",
      species_code == "STRPUR" & size_cm == ">2cm" ~ "purple_urchins_>2cm",
      species_code == "MESFRA" ~ "red_urchins",
      species_code == "TEGULA" ~ "tegula",
      species_code == "TEG_ARK" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ species_code
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
  group_by(survey_id, species) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(count_num),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check the resulting observations
grazer_obs_2025 %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(abundance)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
grazer_2025_wide <- grazer_surveys_2025 %>%
  left_join(
    grazer_obs_2025 %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = species,
        values_from = abundance,
        values_fill = 0
      ),
    by = "survey_id"
  ) %>%
  # Add abalone from the invertebrate survey records
  left_join(
    invert_2025_wide %>%
      select(survey_id, HALRUF, HALKAM),
    by = "survey_id"
  ) %>%
  select(
    survey_id,
    year,
    date,
    site,
    plot_type,
    arkev_unit,
    all_of(grazers)
  )

# Verify the completed dataset
grazer_2025_wide %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_unique_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    n_missing = sum(
      is.na(across(all_of(grazers)))
    ),
    n_all_zero = sum(
      rowSums(across(all_of(grazers))) == 0
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Identify 2025 invertebrate surveys
invert_surveys_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(data_type == "inverts") %>%
  distinct(
    survey_id, year, date, site,
    plot_type, arkev_unit
  )

# Prepare observed invertebrate abundances

  filter(
    data_type == "inverts",
    species_code != "NO_INVERTS"
  ) %>%
  group_by(survey_id, species_code) %>%

# Verify

  surveys_with_inverts = n_distinct(invert_obs_2025$survey_id),
  n_species = n_distinct(invert_obs_2025$species_code),
  n_missing = sum(is.na(invert_obs_2025$abundance))
)
```

```{r}
invert_2025_wide <- invert_surveys_2025 %>%
  left_join(
    invert_obs_2025 %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = species_code,
        values_from = abundance,
        values_fill = 0
      ),
    by = "survey_id"

)

invert_2025_wide %>%
  summarise(
```

```{r}
##match species code

#inverts
# Species present in 2025 but not in the 2026 species list
setdiff(names(invert_2025_wide), c(
  "survey_id", "year", "date", "site",
  "plot_type", "arkev_unit", inverts
))

# Species expected in 2026 but absent from 2025
setdiff(inverts, names(invert_2025_wide))
```

```{r}
invert_2025_std <- invert_2025_wide %>%
  rename(
    CANCERSPP = CANSPP,
    PUGPRO = PUGSPP
  )

# Verify the standardized columns
setdiff(
  inverts,
  names(invert_2025_std)
)
```

```{r}
invert_2026_std <- ki %>%
  transmute(
    survey_id,
    year = 2026,
    date,
    site,
    plot_type,
    arkev_unit,
    across(
      all_of(inverts),
      ~ as.numeric(unlist(.x))
    )
  )

# Check the standardized 2026 dataset
invert_2026_std %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_unique_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(across(all_of(inverts)))),
    n_negative = sum(
      as.matrix(across(all_of(inverts))) < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
invert_2026_std %>%
  mutate(
    n_missing = rowSums(
      is.na(across(all_of(inverts)))
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(n_missing > 0) %>%
  select(
    date,
    site,
    plot_type,
    arkev_unit,
    n_missing
  ) %>%
  arrange(date, site, plot_type, arkev_unit) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
  summarise(
```

```{r}
  )
```

```{r}
kelp_2026_std <- ki %>%
  transmute(
    survey_id,
    year = 2026,
    date,
    site,
    plot_type,
    arkev_unit,
    across(
      all_of(intersect(kelp, names(ki))),
      ~ as.numeric(unlist(.x))

  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_unique_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),

      is.na(across(all_of(intersect(kelp, names(ki)))))
    ),
    n_negative = sum(
      as.matrix(across(all_of(intersect(kelp, names(ki))))) < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
    "control", "arkev", "arkev", "arkev", "arkev",
```

```{r}
community_locations_2025_2026 <- community_2025_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    # Standardize unit identifiers for location matching
    unit_clean = stringr::str_remove(
      arkev_unit, "^[Cc]"
    ),

    plot_number = as.integer(
      stringr::str_extract(unit_clean, "[0-9]+")
    )
  ) %>%

  # Match 2025 Noyo locations to their 2026 counterparts
  left_join(
    noyo_location_crosswalk %>%
      transmute(
        unit_2025,
        noyo_location_id = paste(
          "noyo", plot_type_2026, unit_2026,
          sep = "_"
        )
      ),
    by = c("unit_clean" = "unit_2025")
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    physical_location_id = case_when(

      # 2025 Noyo: use the crosswalk
      site == "noyo" & year == 2025 ~
        noyo_location_id,

      # 2026 Noyo: use the actual 2026 location
      site == "noyo" & year == 2026 ~
        paste(site, plot_type, unit_clean, sep = "_"),

      # Big River plots 8-10 moved between years
      site == "big_river" &
        plot_number %in% 8:10 ~
        paste(site, plot_type, unit_clean, year, sep = "_"),

      # Other Big River locations
      site == "big_river" ~
        paste(site, plot_type, unit_clean, sep = "_"),

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-unit_clean, -noyo_location_id)

# Verify
community_locations_2025_2026 %>%
  group_by(year, site, plot_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_physical_locations = n_distinct(
      physical_location_id, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_unmapped = sum(is.na(physical_location_id)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
      species_code == "ENCRED" ~ "ER",
      species_code %in% c("BR", "BAREROCK") ~ "BR",
      species_code == "TURF" ~ "turf",
      species_code == "FLESHY" ~ "FLESHY",
      species_code == "SCUM" ~ "SCUM",

      species_code %in% c("BS", "SAND", "BARESAND") ~ "SAND",

    plot_type, arkev_unit, taxon
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    cover_raw = if (all(is.na(cover))) {

    .groups = "drop"
```

```{r}
hard_cover_taxa <- c(
  "CCA", "ACA", "ER", "BR", "turf"
)

cover_balance_2025 <- cover_2025 %>%
  group_by(
    survey_id, year, date, site,
    plot_type, arkev_unit
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    hard_cover = sum(
      cover_raw[taxon %in% hard_cover_taxa],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sand_recorded = any(taxon == "SAND"),

    sand_percent = if (any(taxon == "SAND")) {
      cover_raw[taxon == "SAND"][1]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    n_missing_cover = sum(is.na(cover_raw)),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  # Add categorical substrate descriptions
  left_join(
    surveys_2025 %>%
      group_by(survey_id) %>%
      summarise(
        substrate_description = paste(
          sort(unique(
            na.omit(as.character(substrate))
          )),
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "survey_id"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    categorical_sand = str_detect(
      str_to_upper(substrate_description),
      "SAND"
    ),

    total_accounted = hard_cover + coalesce(sand_percent, 0),

    remaining_cover = 100 - total_accounted
  )

# Examine surveys with partial recorded sand
# or categorical sand without a percentage

cover_balance_2025 %>%
  filter(
    (sand_recorded & sand_percent < 100) |
      (!sand_recorded & categorical_sand)
  ) %>%
  select(
    date, site, plot_type, arkev_unit,
    substrate_description,
    hard_cover,
    sand_percent,
    total_accounted,
    remaining_cover,
    n_missing_cover
  ) %>%
  arrange(date, site, plot_type, arkev_unit) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
sand_inference_2025 <- cover_balance_2025 %>%
  filter(
    !sand_recorded,
    categorical_sand
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cover_2025 %>%
      filter(taxon %in% c("FLESHY", "SCUM")) %>%
      select(survey_id, taxon, cover_raw) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = taxon,
        values_from = cover_raw
      ),
    by = "survey_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Potential sand area based on underlying cover only
    sand_upper_bound = if_else(
      hard_cover >= 0 & hard_cover <= 100,
      100 - hard_cover,
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Identify whether other cover layers are present
    fleshy_present = !is.na(FLESHY) & FLESHY > 0,
    scum_present = !is.na(SCUM) & SCUM > 0,

    # Candidate sand estimates, not final values
    sand_candidate = case_when(
      hard_cover == 100 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    inference_status = case_when(
      hard_cover == 100 ~ "Candidate 0% sand",
      fleshy_present | scum_present ~
        "Needs review: overlapping cover",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown sand percentage"
    )
  )

sand_inference_2025 %>%
  select(
    date, site, arkev_unit,
    substrate_description,
    hard_cover, FLESHY, SCUM,
    sand_upper_bound,
    sand_candidate,
    inference_status
  ) %>%
  arrange(date, site, arkev_unit) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
sand_status_2025 %>%
  filter(
    sand_status ==
      "No sand record or categorical indication"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),

    n_zero_hard_cover = sum(
      hard_cover == 0, na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_partial_hard_cover = sum(
      hard_cover > 0 & hard_cover < 100,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_full_hard_cover = sum(
      abs(hard_cover - 100) < 0.001,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_over_100 = sum(
      hard_cover > 100.001,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
sand_2025_values <- sand_status_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    # Sand percentages recorded during surveys
    SAND_measured = if_else(
      sand_recorded,
      sand_percent,
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Infer 0% sand when underlying cover equals 100%
    # and no sand was recorded or indicated
    SAND_inferred = case_when(
      !sand_recorded &
        !categorical_sand &
        abs(hard_cover - 100) < 0.001 ~ 0,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Field-confirmed 0% sand for the nine surveys
    # where underlying cover exceeded 100%
    SAND_field_confirmed = case_when(
      !sand_recorded &
        !categorical_sand &
        hard_cover > 100 ~ 0,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Combine sand values while preserving missing data
    SAND = coalesce(
      SAND_measured,
      SAND_inferred,
      SAND_field_confirmed
    ),

    # Track how each sand percentage was obtained
    sand_source = case_when(
      !is.na(SAND_measured) ~ "Measured",
      !is.na(SAND_field_confirmed) ~ "Field-confirmed 0%",
      !is.na(SAND_inferred) ~ "Inferred 0%",
      categorical_sand ~ "Categorical sand, percentage unknown",
      TRUE ~ "Sand percentage unknown"
    )
  )

# Verify
sand_2025_values %>%
  group_by(site, sand_source) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(site, sand_source)
```

```{r}
cover_2025_adj <- cover_2025 %>%

  # Bring in measured/inferred sand percentages
  left_join(
    sand_2025_values %>%
      select(
        survey_id,
        SAND,
        sand_source
      ),
    by = "survey_id"
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    survey_id, year, date, site,
    plot_type, arkev_unit
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    # Underlying hard-substrate cover
    underlying_cover = sum(
      cover_raw[
        taxon %in% c("CCA", "ACA", "ER", "BR", "turf")
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Available hard substrate
    hard_substrate = 100 - SAND,

    # Preserve original proportional adjustment
    scale_factor = case_when(
      !is.na(hard_substrate) &
        underlying_cover > hard_substrate &
        underlying_cover > 0 ~
          hard_substrate / underlying_cover,

      TRUE ~ 1
    ),

    # Scale biological cover, not sand
    cover_clean = if_else(
      taxon == "SAND",
      cover_raw,
      cover_raw * scale_factor
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Verify adjustments and missing sand
cover_2025_adj %>%
  distinct(
    survey_id,
    SAND,
    sand_source,
    underlying_cover,
    hard_substrate,
    scale_factor
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_sand_available = sum(!is.na(SAND)),
    n_sand_unknown = sum(is.na(SAND)),
    n_adjusted = sum(scale_factor < 1),
    n_unadjusted = sum(scale_factor == 1)
  )
```

```{r}

          100 / underlying_cover,

      TRUE ~ scale_factor
    ),

    # Preserve original proportional scaling approach
    # Do not scale the sand percentage itself
    cover_clean = if_else(
      taxon == "SAND",
      cover_raw,
      cover_raw * scale_factor
    )

# Verify adjustments
```

##site and year permanova
```{r}
library(vegan)
library(permute)

# Big River 2025: dates with all 10 treatment pairs
paired_dates_br25 <- community_plot_date %>%
  filter(year == 2025, site == "big_river") %>%
  group_by(date, plot_number) %>%
  summarise(
    n_treatments = n_distinct(plot_type),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    n_paired = sum(n_treatments == 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_paired == 10) %>%
  pull(date)

# Average abundance across shared sampling dates
br25_paired <- community_plot_date %>%
  filter(
    year == 2025,
    site == "big_river",
    date %in% paired_dates_br25
  ) %>%
  group_by(plot_number, plot_type) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(community_vars), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(plot_number, plot_type)

# Square-root transformed Bray-Curtis distances
br25_dist <- br25_paired %>%
  select(all_of(community_vars)) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  sqrt() %>%
  vegdist(method = "bray")

# Paired PERMANOVA
set.seed(123)

br25_permanova <- adonis2(
  br25_dist ~ factor(plot_number) + plot_type,
  data = br25_paired,
  permutations = how(
    blocks = br25_paired$plot_number,
    nperm = 999
  ),
  by = "margin"
)

br25_permanova
```

```{r}
# Big River 2025: homogeneity of multivariate dispersion

br25_disp <- vegan::betadisper(
  br25_dist,
  group = br25_paired$plot_type,
  type = "median"
)

# Mean distance to group spatial median
aggregate(
  br25_disp$distances,
  by = list(treatment = br25_paired$plot_type),
  FUN = mean
)

# Permutation test restricted within paired plots
set.seed(123)

vegan::permutest(
  br25_disp,
  permutations = permute::how(
    blocks = br25_paired$plot_number,
    nperm = 999
  )
)
```

```{r}
# Noyo 2026: exact paired permutation tests for all grazers

noyo26_grazer_tests <- noyo26_paired %>%
  select(plot_number, plot_type, all_of(grazers)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(grazers),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = plot_type,
    values_from = abundance
  ) %>%
  mutate(difference = arkev - control) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_difference = mean(difference),

    p_value = {
      d <- difference

      # Enumerate all possible treatment-label swaps
      signs <- as.matrix(
        expand.grid(
          rep(list(c(-1, 1)), length(d))
        )
      )

      null_means <- as.vector(signs %*% d) / length(d)

      # Two-sided exact permutation p-value
      mean(
        abs(null_means) >= abs(mean(d)) - 1e-12
      )
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adjusted)

noyo26_grazer_tests
```

###Big river
```{r}
# Big River: 2025–2026 multivariate difference-in-differences

# Calculate the treatment-by-year contrast for each species
# within each of the 7 matched experimental plots

br_change <- br_cross_year_season %>%
  select(
    plot_number,
    year,
    plot_type,
    all_of(community_vars)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(community_vars), sqrt)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(community_vars),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(plot_type, year),
    values_from = abundance,
    names_glue = "{plot_type}_{year}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    change_difference =
      (arkev_2026 - arkev_2025) -
      (control_2026 - control_2025)
  )

# Matrix: 7 plot pairs × 23 species
br_change_matrix <- br_change %>%
  select(plot_number, species, change_difference) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = change_difference
  ) %>%
  arrange(plot_number) %>%
  select(-plot_number) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Observed multivariate difference-in-differences
observed_stat <- sum(
  colMeans(br_change_matrix)^2
)

# Enumerate all 2^7 possible plot-level sign flips
signs <- as.matrix(
  expand.grid(
    rep(list(c(-1, 1)), nrow(br_change_matrix))
  )
)

permutation_stats <- apply(
  signs, 1,
  function(s) {
    sum(
      colMeans(
        br_change_matrix * s
      )^2
    )
  }
)

# Exact paired permutation p-value
tibble(
  n_plot_pairs = nrow(br_change_matrix),
  n_species = ncol(br_change_matrix),
  n_permutations = nrow(signs),
  observed_statistic = observed_stat,
  p_value = mean(
    permutation_stats >= observed_stat - 1e-12
  )
)
```

```{r}
      all_of(community_vars),
      mean
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(community_vars),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "mean_abundance"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = mean_abundance,
    names_prefix = "year_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    change = year_2026 - year_2025
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(change)))

br_site_changes %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Big River: overall community change between years
# Seven matched plots, averaging equally across treatments

br_site_change_matrix <- br_site_year %>%
  select(
    plot_number,
    year,
    all_of(community_vars)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(community_vars), sqrt)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(community_vars),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = abundance,
    names_prefix = "year_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    change = year_2026 - year_2025
  ) %>%
  select(plot_number, species, change) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = change
  ) %>%
  arrange(plot_number) %>%
  select(-plot_number) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Observed multivariate change
observed_stat <- sum(
  colMeans(br_site_change_matrix)^2
)

# All possible paired sign permutations
signs <- as.matrix(
  expand.grid(
    rep(
      list(c(-1, 1)),
      nrow(br_site_change_matrix)
    )
  )
)

permutation_stats <- apply(
  signs, 1,
  function(s) {
    sum(
      colMeans(br_site_change_matrix * s)^2
    )
  }
)

# Exact paired permutation result
tibble(
  n_matched_plots = nrow(br_site_change_matrix),
  n_species = ncol(br_site_change_matrix),
  n_permutations = nrow(signs),
  observed_statistic = observed_stat,
  p_value = mean(
    permutation_stats >= observed_stat - 1e-12
  )
)
```

```{r}
# Noyo: community turnover between July 2025 and 2026
# Matched locations, grouped by 2026 plot number

noyo_community_turnover <- noyo_site_year %>%
  group_by(plot_number) %>%
  group_modify(~ {

    # Order the two community observations by year
    plot_data <- .x %>%
      arrange(year)

    # Square-root transformed biological community
    community_matrix <- plot_data %>%
      select(all_of(community_vars)) %>%
      as.matrix() %>%
      sqrt()

    # Bray-Curtis dissimilarity between years
    tibble(
      bray_curtis_change = as.numeric(
        vegan::vegdist(
          community_matrix,
          method = "bray"
        )
      )
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Examine turnover by plot and overall

noyo_community_turnover

noyo_community_turnover %>%
  summarise(
    n_plots = n(),
    mean_turnover = mean(bray_curtis_change),
    min_turnover = min(bray_curtis_change),
    max_turnover = max(bray_curtis_change)
  )
```

```{r}
# Big River: exact paired tests for biological group totals

br_group_tests <- br_group_changes %>%
  group_by(community_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_change = mean(change),
    median_change = median(change),

    p_value = {
      d <- change

      signs <- as.matrix(
        expand.grid(
          rep(list(c(-1, 1)), length(d))
        )
      )

      null_means <- as.vector(signs %*% d) / length(d)

      mean(
        abs(null_means) >= abs(mean(d)) - 1e-12
      )
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adjusted)

br_group_tests
```

```{r}
# Big River: relate changes in cover categories
# to changes in kelp abundance

# Average cover across the four shared months

  group_by(
    year,
    plot_number,
    plot_type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(CCA, ACA, ER, BR, turf, FLESHY, SCUM),
      mean
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join cover with kelp and grazer abundance
br_cover_kelp <- br_cross_year_season %>%
  mutate(
    kelp_total = rowSums(
      pick(all_of(shared_kelp))
    ),
    grazer_total = rowSums(
      pick(all_of(grazers))
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    year,
    plot_number,
    plot_type,
    kelp_total,
    grazer_total
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    br_cover_season,
    by = c("year", "plot_number", "plot_type"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  )

# Calculate cross-year changes
br_cover_kelp_changes <- br_cover_kelp %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = c(
      kelp_total, grazer_total,
      CCA, ACA, ER, BR, turf, FLESHY, SCUM
    ),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{year}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    change_kelp_total = kelp_total_2026 - kelp_total_2025,
    change_grazer_total = grazer_total_2026 - grazer_total_2025,
    change_CCA = CCA_2026 - CCA_2025,
    change_ACA = ACA_2026 - ACA_2025,
    change_ER = ER_2026 - ER_2025,
    change_BR = BR_2026 - BR_2025,
    change_turf = turf_2026 - turf_2025,
    change_FLESHY = FLESHY_2026 - FLESHY_2025,
    change_SCUM = SCUM_2026 - SCUM_2025
  )

# Inspect paired changes
br_cover_kelp_changes %>%
  select(
    plot_number,
    plot_type,
    change_kelp_total,
    change_grazer_total,
    change_CCA,
    change_ACA,
    change_ER,
    change_BR,
    change_turf,
    change_FLESHY,
    change_SCUM
  ) %>%
  arrange(plot_number, plot_type)
```

```{r}
# Big River: paired treatment differences in changes
# from 2025 to 2026

  select(
    plot_number,
    plot_type,
    starts_with("change_")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("change_"),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "change"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = sub("^change_", "", variable)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = plot_type,
    values_from = change
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    arkev_minus_control = arkev - control
  )

# Summarize consistency across the 7 paired plots
br_paired_trends_summary <- br_paired_trends %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_arkev_change = mean(arkev),
    mean_control_change = mean(control),

    mean_treatment_difference = mean(arkev_minus_control),

    plots_arkev_higher = sum(arkev_minus_control > 0),
    plots_control_higher = sum(arkev_minus_control < 0),
    plots_equal = sum(arkev_minus_control == 0),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable)

br_paired_trends_summary %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Big River: exact paired tests for treatment differences
# in cross-year benthic cover changes

cover_categories <- c(
  "CCA", "ACA", "ER", "BR",
  "turf", "FLESHY", "SCUM"
)

exact_paired_test <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]

  signs <- as.matrix(
    expand.grid(
      rep(list(c(-1, 1)), length(x))
    )
  )

  observed <- abs(mean(x))

  permuted <- abs(
    as.vector(signs %*% x) / length(x)
  )

  mean(permuted >= observed - 1e-10)
}

br_cover_treatment_tests <- br_paired_trends %>%
  filter(variable %in% cover_categories) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_arkev_change = mean(arkev),
    mean_control_change = mean(control),

    treatment_difference = mean(
      arkev_minus_control
    ),

    n_pairs = n(),

    p_value = exact_paired_test(
      arkev_minus_control
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

br_cover_treatment_tests %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Figure 6: Big River cross-year biological community PCoA

library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Community matrix
br_pcoa_comm <- br_cross_year_season %>%
  select(all_of(community_vars)) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Check that all observations have valid community data
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(br_pcoa_comm),
  all(rowSums(br_pcoa_comm) > 0)
)

# Square-root transformation and Bray-Curtis distance
br_pcoa_dist <- vegdist(
  sqrt(br_pcoa_comm),
  method = "bray"
)

# Principal coordinates analysis
# Additive correction for non-Euclidean distances
br_pcoa <- cmdscale(
  br_pcoa_dist,
  k = 2,
  eig = TRUE,
  add = TRUE
)

# Percentage of positive eigenvalue variation
positive_eig <- br_pcoa$eig[br_pcoa$eig > 0]

axis_variation <- 100 *
  br_pcoa$eig[1:2] /
  sum(positive_eig)

# Attach coordinates to sampling information
br_pcoa_scores <- br_cross_year_season %>%
  select(
    year,
    plot_number,
    plot_type
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    PCoA1 = br_pcoa$points[, 1],
    PCoA2 = br_pcoa$points[, 2],
    year = factor(year),
    plot_type = factor(
      plot_type,
      levels = c("arkev", "control"),
      labels = c("ARKEV", "Control")
    )
  )

# Plot matched trajectories
ggplot(
  br_pcoa_scores,
  aes(
    x = PCoA1,
    y = PCoA2
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      group = interaction(plot_number, plot_type),
      color = plot_type
    ),
    alpha = 0.45,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = plot_type,
      shape = year
    ),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("2025" = 16, "2026" = 17)
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Biological community changes at Big River",
    subtitle = paste(
      "PCoA of square-root-transformed",
      "Bray-Curtis dissimilarity"
    ),
    x = paste0(
      "PCoA 1 (",
      round(axis_variation[1], 1),
      "%)"
    ),
    y = paste0(
      "PCoA 2 (",
      round(axis_variation[2], 1),
      "%)"
    ),
    color = "Treatment",
    shape = "Year",
    caption = paste(
      "Lines connect the same plot-treatment",
      "combination across years."
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
# Figure 7: Noyo cross-year biological community PCoA
# July 2025–2026, 14 matched physical locations

noyo_pcoa_data <- community_cover_2025_2026 %>%
  filter(
    site == "noyo",
    year %in% c(2025, 2026),
    lubridate::month(date) == 7
  ) %>%
  semi_join(
    noyo_july_matched %>%
      distinct(physical_location_id),
    by = "physical_location_id"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, physical_location_id) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(community_vars), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    noyo_2026_groups,
    by = "physical_location_id",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  arrange(physical_location_id, year)

# Check the 14 matched locations are present in both years
stopifnot(
  nrow(noyo_pcoa_data) == 28,
  n_distinct(noyo_pcoa_data$physical_location_id) == 14
)

# Community matrix
noyo_pcoa_comm <- noyo_pcoa_data %>%
  select(all_of(community_vars)) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Bray-Curtis requires special care for all-zero communities
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(noyo_pcoa_comm),
  all(rowSums(noyo_pcoa_comm) > 0)
)

# Square-root-transformed Bray-Curtis
noyo_pcoa_dist <- vegan::vegdist(
  sqrt(noyo_pcoa_comm),
  method = "bray"
)

# Principal coordinates analysis
noyo_pcoa <- cmdscale(
  noyo_pcoa_dist,
  k = 2,
  eig = TRUE,
  add = TRUE
)

positive_eig <- noyo_pcoa$eig[noyo_pcoa$eig > 0]

noyo_axis_variation <- 100 *
  noyo_pcoa$eig[1:2] /
  sum(positive_eig)

# Extract coordinates
noyo_pcoa_scores <- noyo_pcoa_data %>%
  select(
    year,
    physical_location_id,
    treatment_2026
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    PCoA1 = noyo_pcoa$points[, 1],
    PCoA2 = noyo_pcoa$points[, 2],
    year = factor(year),
    treatment_2026 = factor(
      treatment_2026,
      levels = c("arkev", "control"),
      labels = c("ARKEV", "Control")
    )
  )

# Plot paired community trajectories
ggplot(
  noyo_pcoa_scores,
  aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2)
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      group = physical_location_id,
      color = treatment_2026
    ),
    alpha = 0.45,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = treatment_2026,
      shape = year
    ),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("2025" = 16, "2026" = 17)
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Biological community changes at Noyo",
    subtitle = paste(
      "PCoA of square-root-transformed",
      "Bray-Curtis dissimilarity"
    ),
    x = paste0(
      "PCoA 1 (",
      round(noyo_axis_variation[1], 1),
      "%)"
    ),
    y = paste0(
      "PCoA 2 (",
      round(noyo_axis_variation[2], 1),
      "%)"
    ),
    color = "2026 designation",
    shape = "Year",
    caption = paste(
      "Lines connect matched physical locations.",
      "Groups use 2026 treatment classifications."
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
#got too in weeds here,  Relationships between benthic habitat, grazers, and kelp
# Big River: within-year associations between
# benthic cover, grazing, and kelp abundance

br_cover_kelp_correlations <- br_cover_kelp %>%
  select(
    year,
    plot_number,
    plot_type,
    kelp_total,
    grazer_total,
    CCA, ACA, ER, BR, turf, FLESHY, SCUM
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      grazer_total,
      CCA, ACA, ER, BR, turf, FLESHY, SCUM
    ),
    names_to = "predictor",
    values_to = "predictor_value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, predictor) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(
      complete.cases(kelp_total, predictor_value)
    ),
    spearman_rho = if (
      n_distinct(predictor_value, na.rm = TRUE) > 1 &&
      n_distinct(kelp_total, na.rm = TRUE) > 1
    ) {
      cor(
        kelp_total,
        predictor_value,
        method = "spearman",
        use = "complete.obs"
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(predictor, year)
```

```{r}
        size_cm == "<2cm"
      ]
    ),

    large_purple = sum(
      count_num[
        species_code == "STRPUR" &
        size_cm == ">2cm"
      ]
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
```

```{r}
# Combine all valid 2025–2026 surveys

urchin_all <- bind_rows(
  urchins_2025,
  urchins_2026
) %>%
  mutate(
    site = str_replace_all(
      tolower(trimws(site)), " ", "_"
    ),
    plot_number = as.integer(
      str_extract(arkev_unit, "^\\d+")
    ),
    block_id = paste(site, plot_number, sep = "."),
    month_date = floor_date(date, "month")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    site %in% c("big_river", "noyo"),
    !is.na(plot_number)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(small_purple, large_purple),
    names_to = "size_class",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    size_class = recode(
      size_class,
      small_purple = "Small (<2 cm)",
      large_purple = "Large (>2 cm)"
    ),
    density = count / pi
  )
```

```{r}
# Average surveyed units within each block Then calculate site-wide monthly means

urchin_block_month <- urchin_all %>%
  group_by(
    site, year, month_date,
    block_id, size_class
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    density = mean(density),
    n_surveys = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

urchin_monthly <- urchin_block_month %>%
  group_by(
    site, year, month_date, size_class
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_blocks = n(),
    n_surveys = sum(n_surveys),
    mean_density = mean(density),
    se_density = if (n() > 1)
      sd(density) / sqrt(n())
    else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check sampling effort
urchin_monthly %>%
  arrange(site, year, month_date, size_class) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Shared plotting function

make_urchin_figure <- function(site_name, title_text) {

  ggplot(
    urchin_monthly %>%
      filter(site == site_name),
    aes(
      x = month_date,
      y = mean_density,
      color = size_class,
      group = interaction(year, size_class)
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_point(size = 2.7) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = pmax(0, mean_density - se_density),
        ymax = mean_density + se_density
      ),
      width = 5,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Small (<2 cm)" = "#0072B2",
        "Large (>2 cm)" = "#D55E00"
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_date(
      date_breaks = "2 months",
      date_labels = "%b\n%Y"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = "All surveyed plots, 2025–2026; mean ± SE",
      x = "Month",
      y = expression(
        "Purple urchin density (individuals " * m^-2 * ")"
      ),
      color = "Size class"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      )
    )
}


urchin_big_river <- make_urchin_figure(
  "big_river",
  "Purple Urchin Density — Big River"
)

urchin_noyo <- make_urchin_figure(
  "noyo",
  "Purple Urchin Density — Noyo"
)

print(urchin_big_river)
print(urchin_noyo)
```

```{r}
taxon_tests <- ki_2025_2026 %>%
  select(
    year, site,
    all_of(c(grazers, kelp, inverts))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(c(grazers, kelp, inverts)),
    names_to = "taxon",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, taxon) %>%
  summarise(
    test = list(wilcox.test(abundance ~ year, exact = FALSE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = map_dbl(test, ~ unname(.x$statistic)),
    p_value = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(site, taxon, statistic, p_value) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(site, p_adjusted)
```

```{r}
community_taxa <- c(grazers, kelp, inverts)

ki_metrics <- ki_permanova %>%
  mutate(
    total_abundance = rowSums(
      select(., all_of(community_taxa))
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(community_taxa),
      ~ .x / 3.14,
      .names = "{.col}_density"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(community_taxa),
      ~ .x / total_abundance * 100,
      .names = "{.col}_relative"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
density_relative_change <- ki_metrics %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(community_taxa),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{.col}_abundance"
    ),
    across(
      all_of(paste0(community_taxa, "_density")),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    across(
      all_of(paste0(community_taxa, "_relative")),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

density_relative_change <- ki_metrics %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(community_taxa),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{.col}_abundance"
    ),
    across(
      all_of(community_taxa),
      ~ mean(.x / 3.14, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{.col}_density"
    ),
    across(
      all_of(community_taxa),
      ~ mean(.x / total_abundance * 100, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "{.col}_relative"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(site, year),
    names_to = c("taxon", "metric"),
    names_pattern = "(.+)_(abundance|density|relative)$",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = value,
    names_prefix = "year_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    change = year_2026 - year_2025
  )
```

```{R}
  )

ggplot(
  plot_dat,
  aes(
    x = grazer_density,
    y = kelp_density,
    shape = year
  )
) +

  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.40,
    size = 1.8
  ) +

  # Same relationship estimated separately by year
  geom_smooth(
    aes(
      linetype = year
    ),
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(taxon),
    cols = vars(site),
    scales = "free_y",
    switch = "y"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Kelp density in relation to grazer density",
    subtitle = "Kelp taxa with significant negative grazer-density relationships",
    x = "Grazer density (individuals / m²)",
    y = "Kelp density (individuals / m²)",
    shape = "Year",
    linetype = "Year"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +

  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = "white"
    ),

    strip.placement = "outside",

    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),

    legend.position = "top",

    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Site-wide 2025–2026 kelp
# All valid surveys, regardless of treatment or matching

kelp_sitewide <- kelp_2025_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = as.integer(year),
    site = str_replace_all(
      str_to_lower(str_trim(site)), " ", "_"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    year %in% c(2025, 2026),
    site %in% c("big_river", "noyo"),
    if_all(all_of(shared_kelp), ~ !is.na(.x))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    month = month(date),
    kelp_total = rowSums(pick(all_of(shared_kelp))),
    kelp_density = kelp_total / pi
  )

# Monthly site-wide summary
# Average surveys within dates, then dates within months

kelp_sitewide_monthly <- kelp_sitewide %>%
  group_by(site, year, month, date) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    mean_date_density = mean(kelp_density),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    n_dates = n(),
    n_surveys = sum(n_surveys),
    mean_density = mean(mean_date_density),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kelp_sitewide_monthly %>%
  arrange(site, year, month) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Extract plot numbers regardless of the C prefix
# Include ALL valid 2025 and 2026 surveys

kelp_block_month <- kelp_sitewide %>%
  mutate(
    plot_number = as.integer(
      stringr::str_extract(arkev_unit, "\\d+")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    site, year, month, date, plot_number
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    block_date_density = mean(kelp_density),
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    site, year, month, plot_number
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    block_month_density = mean(block_date_density),
    n_surveys = sum(n_surveys),
    n_dates = n_distinct(date),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate monthly site-wide means and SE
kelp_month_summary <- kelp_block_month %>%
  group_by(site, year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    n_blocks = n(),
    n_surveys = sum(n_surveys),
    mean_density = mean(block_month_density),
    se_density = if (n() > 1) {
      sd(block_month_density) / sqrt(n())
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Verify that all valid surveys are retained
kelp_month_summary %>%
  arrange(site, year, month) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Check for any surveys with unrecognized plot numbers
kelp_sitewide %>%
  filter(
    is.na(
      stringr::str_extract(arkev_unit, "\\d+")
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(site, year, arkev_unit)
```

```{r}
# Function to plot each site separately
make_kelp_site_fig <- function(site_name, title_text) {

  ggplot(
    kelp_plot_data %>%
      filter(site == site_name),
    aes(
      x = month,
      y = mean_density,
      color = year,
      group = year
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2.8) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = pmax(0, mean_density - se_density),
        ymax = mean_density + se_density
      ),
      width = 0.12,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = year_colors
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 4:10,
      labels = month.abb[4:10]
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = "All valid surveys; mean ± SE across blocks",
      x = "Month",
      y = expression(
        "Kelp density (individuals " * m^-2 * ")"
      ),
      color = "Year"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)

# Prepare site-wide kelp occurrence data
kelp_occ_model <- kelp_sitewide %>%
  mutate(
    kelp_present = as.integer(kelp_total > 0),

    site = factor(
      site,
      levels = c("big_river", "noyo")
    ),

    year = factor(
      year,
      levels = c(2025, 2026)
    ),

    month = factor(month),

    plot_number = as.integer(
      str_extract(arkev_unit, "\\d+")
    ),

    # Different block identities for each year
    site_year_block = interaction(
      site, year, plot_number,
      drop = TRUE
    ),

    # Surveys collected on the same site-date
    site_date = interaction(
      site, date,
      drop = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(plot_number),
    !is.na(kelp_present)
  )

# Model without site × year interaction
kelp_occ_additive <- glmer(
  kelp_present ~ site + year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block) +
    (1 | site_date),
  data = kelp_occ_model,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)

# Model with site × year interaction
kelp_occ_interaction <- glmer(
  kelp_present ~ site * year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block) +
    (1 | site_date),
  data = kelp_occ_model,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)

# Inspect model results
summary(kelp_occ_interaction)

# Test whether year differences vary between sites
anova(
  kelp_occ_additive,
  kelp_occ_interaction,
  test = "Chisq"
)

# Check for singular fits
isSingular(kelp_occ_interaction)
```

```{r}
# Check sample sizes

# Additive model

    (1 | site_year_block) +
    (1 | site_date),
  data = kelp_occ_shared,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)

# Interaction model

  kelp_present ~ site * year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block) +
    (1 | site_date),
  data = kelp_occ_shared,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
  )
)

# Results
summary(kelp_occ_shared_int)

anova(
  kelp_occ_shared_add,
  kelp_occ_shared_int,
  test = "Chisq"
)

isSingular(kelp_occ_shared_int)
```

```{r}
library(glmmTMB)

# Full-season kelp abundance model
# All valid 2025–2026 surveys
# No treatment factor

# Additive model
kelp_count_add <- glmmTMB(
  kelp_total ~ site + year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block) +
    (1 | site_date),
  data = kelp_occ_model,
  family = nbinom2
)

# Site × Year interaction model
kelp_count_int <- glmmTMB(
  kelp_total ~ site * year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block) +
    (1 | site_date),
  data = kelp_occ_model,
  family = nbinom2
)

# Examine the interaction model
summary(kelp_count_int)

# Test whether year differences vary by site
anova(
  kelp_count_add,
  kelp_count_int
)

# Check model convergence
kelp_count_int$fit$convergence

# Check for positive-definite Hessian
kelp_count_int$sdr$pdHess
```

```{r}
# Prepare kelp community data at the block-date level
# All valid surveys, no treatment distinction

kelp_comm_block_date <- kelp_sitewide %>%
  mutate(
    plot_number = as.integer(
      stringr::str_extract(arkev_unit, "\\d+")
    )

  group_by(
    site, year, date, month, plot_number
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(shared_kelp),
      mean
    ),
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_kelp = rowSums(

    )

  group_by(site, year) %>%

    ),

    n_zero_block_dates = sum(
      total_kelp == 0
    ),

    n_positive_blocks = n_distinct(
      plot_number[total_kelp > 0]
    ),

    mean_groups_when_present = if (
      any(total_kelp > 0)
    ) {
      mean(n_kelp_groups[total_kelp > 0])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )

kelp_comm_coverage %>%
  arrange(site, year) %>%
```

```{r}
# Relative kelp community composition
# All valid surveys, no treatment factor
# Block-date means used to avoid subplot pseudoreplication

kelp_composition <- kelp_comm_block_date %>%
  filter(total_kelp > 0) %>%
  select(
    site, year, date, plot_number,
    all_of(shared_kelp)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(shared_kelp),
    names_to = "kelp_group",
    values_to = "mean_count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year, kelp_group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(mean_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  mutate(
    relative_abundance = 100 *
      mean_abundance / sum(mean_abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(site, year, desc(relative_abundance))

# Display community composition percentages
kelp_composition %>%
  select(
    site, year, kelp_group,
    mean_abundance, relative_abundance
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
make_kelp_hurricane <- function(site_name) {
  ggplot(
    kelp_hurricane_data %>% filter(site == site_name),
    aes(
      x = plot_abundance,
      y = kelp_group,
      fill = year
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.7,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = year_colors,
      name = "Year"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-100, 100, 25),
      labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-105, 105)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Kelp Community Composition, 2025–2026 —", site_name),
      subtitle = "Relative abundance among kelp-positive block-dates",
      x = "Relative abundance (%)",
      y = "Kelp group"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

```{r}
# All valid surveys, no treatment distinction
# Excludes HALRUF and HALKAM

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Define invertebrate variables, excluding abalone
invert_vars_used <- setdiff(
  inverts,
  c("HALRUF", "HALKAM")
)

# Prepare site-wide invertebrate dataset
invert_sitewide <- invert_2025_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = as.integer(year),
    site = str_replace_all(
      str_to_lower(str_trim(site)), " ", "_"
    ),
    plot_number = as.integer(
      str_extract(as.character(arkev_unit), "\\d+")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    year %in% c(2025, 2026),
    site %in% c("big_river", "noyo"),
    !is.na(date),
    !is.na(plot_number),
    if_all(all_of(invert_vars_used), ~ !is.na(.x))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    month = month(date),
    invert_total = rowSums(
      pick(all_of(invert_vars_used))
    ),
    invert_present = as.integer(invert_total > 0),
    invert_density = invert_total / pi
  )

# Annual distribution and sampling coverage
invert_distribution <- invert_sitewide %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    n_blocks = n_distinct(plot_number),
    n_with_inverts = sum(invert_present),
    n_without_inverts = sum(!invert_present),
    pct_with_inverts = 100 * mean(invert_present),
    mean_count = mean(invert_total),
    median_count = median(invert_total),
    variance_count = var(invert_total),
    mean_density = mean(invert_density),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(invert_distribution, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# INVERTEBRATES: Seasonal figures
# Excludes HALRUF and HALKAM
# No treatment factor

invert_plot_data <- invert_month_summary %>%
  mutate(
    year = factor(year, levels = c(2025, 2026))
  )

year_colors <- c(
  "2025" = "#D55E00",
  "2026" = "#0072B2"
)

make_invert_fig <- function(
  site_name,
  response = c("density", "occurrence")
) {

  response <- match.arg(response)

  mean_col <- if (response == "density") {
    "mean_density"
  } else {
    "mean_occurrence"
  }

  se_col <- if (response == "density") {
    "se_density"
  } else {
    "se_occurrence"
  }

  y_label <- if (response == "density") {
    expression(
      "Invertebrate density (ind   " * m^-2 * ")"
    )
  } else {
    "Invertebrate occurrence (%)"
  }

  title_text <- if (response == "density") {
    "Invertebrate Density"
  } else {
    "Invertebrate Occurrence"
  }

  ggplot(
    invert_plot_data %>%
      filter(site == site_name),
    aes(
      x = month,
      y = .data[[mean_col]],
      color = year,
      group = year
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2.8) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = pmax(
          0,
          .data[[mean_col]] - .data[[se_col]]
        ),
        ymax = .data[[mean_col]] + .data[[se_col]]
      ),
      width = 0.12,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = year_colors
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 4:10,
      labels = month.abb[4:10]
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        title_text,
        "—",
        if_else(
          site_name == "big_river",
          "Big River",
          "Noyo"
        )
      ),
      x = "Month",
      y = y_label,
      color = "Year"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

# Density figures
invert_density_big_river <- make_invert_fig(
  "big_river", "density"
)

invert_density_noyo <- make_invert_fig(
  "noyo", "density"
)

  "big_river", "occurrence"
)

invert_occ_noyo <- make_invert_fig(
  "noyo", "occurrence"
)
```

```{r}
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)

# Shared-season invertebrate abundance
# July–August, all valid surveys
# Excludes HALRUF and HALKAM
# No treatment factor

invert_model_shared <- invert_sitewide %>%
  filter(month %in% c(7, 8)) %>%
  mutate(
    site = factor(
      site,
      levels = c("big_river", "noyo")
    ),
    year = factor(
      year,
      levels = c(2025, 2026)
    ),
    month = factor(month),

    site_year_block = interaction(
      site, year, plot_number,
      drop = TRUE
    )
  )

# Check sample sizes
invert_model_shared %>%
  group_by(site, year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_blocks = n_distinct(site_year_block),
    mean_count = mean(invert_total),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Additive model
invert_count_add <- glmmTMB(
  invert_total ~ site + year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block),
  data = invert_model_shared,
  family = poisson
)

# Site × Year interaction model
invert_count_int <- glmmTMB(
  invert_total ~ site * year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block),
  data = invert_model_shared,
  family = poisson
)

# Model results
summary(invert_count_int)

# Test interaction
anova(
  invert_count_add,
  invert_count_int
)

# Check convergence
invert_count_int$fit$convergence
invert_count_int$sdr$pdHess

# Residual diagnostics
set.seed(123)

invert_count_res <- simulateResiduals(
  invert_count_int,
  n = 1000
)

plot(invert_count_res)

testDispersion(invert_count_res)
testZeroInflation(invert_count_res)
```

```{r}
# INVERTEBRATE COMMUNITY COMPOSITION
# 2025–2026, all valid surveys
# Excludes HALRUF and HALKAM
# No treatment factor

#Average survey counts within each block and date

invert_comm_block_date <- invert_sitewide %>%
  group_by(
    site, year, date, plot_number
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(invert_vars_used),
      mean
    ),
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_inverts = rowSums(
      pick(all_of(invert_vars_used))
    )
  )

#Calculate composition among invertebrate-positive block-dates

invert_composition <- invert_comm_block_date %>%
  filter(total_inverts > 0) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(invert_vars_used),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "mean_count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year, species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(mean_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  mutate(
    relative_abundance = 100 *
      mean_abundance / sum(mean_abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Define colors

year_colors <- c(
  "2025" = "#D55E00",
  "2026" = "#0072B2"
)

#PLot
make_invert_hurricane <- function(site_name) {

  site_data <- invert_composition %>%
    filter(site == site_name)

  # Select the six most prominent species at this site
  focal_species <- site_data %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    summarise(
      combined_share = sum(relative_abundance),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    slice_max(
      combined_share,
      n = 6,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) %>%
    pull(species)

  plot_data <- site_data %>%
    mutate(
      species_plot = if_else(
        species %in% focal_species,
        species,
        "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(year, species_plot) %>%
    summarise(
      relative_abundance = sum(relative_abundance),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = factor(year, levels = c(2025, 2026)),
      species_plot = factor(
        species_plot,
        levels = rev(c(focal_species, "Other"))
      ),
      plot_abundance = if_else(
        year == "2025",
        -relative_abundance,
        relative_abundance
      )
    )

  site_title <- if (
    site_name == "big_river"
  ) {
    "Big River"
  } else {
    "Noyo"
  }

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = plot_abundance,
      y = species_plot,
      fill = year
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.7,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = year_colors,
      name = "Year"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-100, 100, 25),
      labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%")
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-105, 105)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Invertebrate Community Composition —",
        site_title
      ),
      subtitle = "Relative abundance among invertebrate-positive block-dates",
      x = "Relative abundance (%)",
      y = "Invertebrate group"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

)

)
```

```{r}
# All valid surveys, no treatment distinction
# Includes urchins, Tegula, and abalone

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

grazer_sitewide <- grazer_2025_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = as.integer(year),
    site = str_replace_all(
      str_to_lower(str_trim(site)), " ", "_"
    ),
    plot_number = as.integer(
      str_extract(as.character(arkev_unit), "\\d+")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    year %in% c(2025, 2026),
    site %in% c("big_river", "noyo"),
    !is.na(date),
    !is.na(plot_number),
    if_all(all_of(grazers), ~ !is.na(.x))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    month = month(date),
    grazer_total = rowSums(pick(all_of(grazers))),
    grazer_present = as.integer(grazer_total > 0),
    grazer_density = grazer_total / pi
  )

# Annual distribution and survey coverage

grazer_distribution <- grazer_sitewide %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    n_blocks = n_distinct(plot_number),
    n_with_grazers = sum(grazer_present),
    n_without_grazers = sum(!grazer_present),
    pct_with_grazers = 100 * mean(grazer_present),
    mean_count = mean(grazer_total),
    median_count = median(grazer_total),
    variance_count = var(grazer_total),
    mean_density = mean(grazer_density),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(grazer_distribution, n = Inf)

# Average all subplots within each block and date

grazer_block_date <- grazer_sitewide %>%
  group_by(site, year, month, date, plot_number) %>%
  summarise(
    block_date_density = mean(grazer_density),
    block_date_occurrence = mean(grazer_present),
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Average dates within blocks and months

grazer_block_month <- grazer_block_date %>%
  group_by(site, year, month, plot_number) %>%
  summarise(
    block_month_density = mean(block_date_density),
    block_month_occurrence = mean(block_date_occurrence),
    n_surveys = sum(n_surveys),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Monthly site-wide summaries

grazer_month_summary <- grazer_block_month %>%
  group_by(site, year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    n_blocks = n(),
    n_surveys = sum(n_surveys),

    mean_density = mean(block_month_density),
    se_density = if (n() > 1) {
      sd(block_month_density) / sqrt(n())
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    mean_occurrence = 100 * mean(block_month_occurrence),
    se_occurrence = if (n() > 1) {
      100 * sd(block_month_occurrence) / sqrt(n())
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(grazer_month_summary, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# GRAZER ABUNDANCE: Full 2025–2026 dataset

  mutate(
    site = factor(
      site,

    ),
    year = factor(
      year,
      levels = c(2025, 2026)
    ),
    month = factor(month),

    site_year_block = interaction(
      site, year, plot_number,
      drop = TRUE
    ),

    site_date = interaction(
      site, date,
      drop = TRUE
    )
  )

  grazer_total ~ site + year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block) +
    (1 | site_date),
  data = grazer_model_full,
  family = nbinom2
)

# Interaction model

  grazer_total ~ site * year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block) +
    (1 | site_date),
  data = grazer_model_full,
  family = nbinom2
)

# Model results

anova(
  grazer_count_full_add,
  grazer_count_full_int
)

# Convergence checks
grazer_count_full_int$fit$convergence
grazer_count_full_int$sdr$pdHess

# Random-effect variances
VarCorr(grazer_count_full_int)
```

```{r}
# GRAZER COMMUNITY COMPOSITION: 2025–2026
# All valid surveys, no treatment distinction

#Average grazer counts within each block and date

grazer_comm_block_date <- grazer_sitewide %>%
  group_by(site, year, date, plot_number) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(grazers), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_grazers = rowSums(
      pick(all_of(grazers))
    )
  )

#Calculate relative composition among positive block-dates
grazer_composition <- grazer_comm_block_date %>%
  filter(total_grazers > 0) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(grazers),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "mean_count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year, species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(mean_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  mutate(
    relative_abundance = 100 *
      mean_abundance / sum(mean_abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#Calculate absolute density for the labels
grazer_density_labels <- grazer_comm_block_date %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(grazers),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "mean_count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year, species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_density = mean(mean_count) / pi,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Combine density with relative abundance
grazer_composition_labeled <- grazer_composition %>%
  left_join(
    grazer_density_labels,
    by = c("site", "year", "species")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    density_label = case_when(
      mean_density == 0 ~ "",
      mean_density < 0.01 ~ sprintf("%.3f", mean_density),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", mean_density)
    )
  )

#Updated hurricane plot function
make_grazer_hurricane <- function(site_name) {

  plot_data <- grazer_composition_labeled %>%
    filter(site == site_name)

  species_order <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    summarise(
      combined_share = sum(relative_abundance),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(combined_share)) %>%
    pull(species)

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      year = factor(year, levels = c(2025, 2026)),
      species = factor(species, levels = rev(species_order)),
      plot_abundance = if_else(
        year == "2025",
        -relative_abundance,
        relative_abundance
      ),
      label_x = if_else(
        year == "2025",
        plot_abundance - 2,
        plot_abundance + 2
      ),
      label_hjust = if_else(year == "2025", 1, 0)
    )

  site_title <- if (
    site_name == "big_river"
  ) "Big River" else "Noyo"

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = plot_abundance, y = species, fill = year)
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.7,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        x = label_x,
        label = density_label,
        hjust = label_hjust
      ),
      size = 3.3,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "2025" = "#D55E00",
        "2026" = "#0072B2"
      ),
      name = "Year"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-100, 100, 25),
      labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%")
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      labels = c(
        "purple_urchins_<2cm" = "Purple urchins <2 cm",
        "purple_urchins_>2cm" = "Purple urchins >2 cm",
        "red_urchins" = "Red urchins",
        "tegula" = "Tegula",
        "HALRUF" = "Red abalone",
        "HALKAM" = "Pinto abalone"
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-115, 115)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Grazer Community —", site_title),
      x = "Relative abundance (%)",
      y = "Grazer group"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

#Recreate both figures

grazer_hurricane_big_river <- make_grazer_hurricane("big_river")
grazer_hurricane_noyo <- make_grazer_hurricane("noyo")

print(grazer_hurricane_big_river)
print(grazer_hurricane_noyo)
```

```{r}
  "tegula" = "Tegula",
  "HALRUF" = "Red abalone",
  "HALKAM" = "Pinto abalone"
)

# Same horizontal scale for both sites
max_density <- max(grazer_species_density$mean_density)

# Plot function
make_grazer_density_hurricane <- function(site_name) {

  plot_data <- grazer_species_density %>%
    filter(site == site_name) %>%
    mutate(
      year = factor(year, levels = c(2025, 2026)),
      species = factor(species, levels = species_order),
      plot_density = if_else(
        year == "2025",
        -mean_density,
        mean_density
      )
    )

  site_title <- if (
    site_name == "big_river"
  ) "Big River" else "Noyo"

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = plot_density,
      y = species,
      fill = year
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.7,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = if_else(
          mean_density >= 0.01,
          sprintf("%.2f", mean_density),
          ""
        ),
        hjust = if_else(year == "2025", 1.1, -0.1)
      ),
      size = 3.4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "2025" = "#D55E00",
        "2026" = "#0072B2"
      ),
      name = "Year"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = function(x) abs(x)
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      labels = grazer_labels
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-max_density * 1.25,
                max_density * 1.25)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Grazer Density —",
        site_title
      ),
      x = expression("Mean density (individuals/m"^2*")"),
      y = "Grazer group"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

# Separate density figures

grazer_density_big_river <- make_grazer_density_hurricane(
  "big_river"
)

grazer_density_noyo <- make_grazer_density_hurricane(
  "noyo"
)

print(grazer_density_big_river)
print(grazer_density_noyo)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# Prepare benthic cover data
cover_sitewide <- cover_compare %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = as.integer(as.character(year)),
    site = str_replace_all(
      str_to_lower(str_trim(site)), " ", "_"
    ),
    month = as.integer(format(date, "%m")),
    plot_number = as.integer(
      str_extract(as.character(arkev_unit), "\\d+")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    year %in% c(2025, 2026),
    site %in% c("big_river", "noyo"),
    !is.na(date),
    !is.na(plot_number)
  )

# Annual coverage and descriptive statistics
cover_distribution <- cover_sitewide %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_surveys = n(),
    n_valid_algal = sum(!is.na(algal_cover)),
    n_blocks = n_distinct(
      plot_number[!is.na(algal_cover)]
    ),
    n_missing_sand = sum(is.na(SAND)),
    mean_algal = mean(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_algal = median(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_algal = sd(algal_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_zero_algal = 100 * mean(
      algal_cover[!is.na(algal_cover)] == 0
    ),
    mean_CCA = mean(CCA, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ACA = mean(ACA, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ER = mean(ER, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_BR = mean(BR, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_turf = mean(turf, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_FLESHY = mean(FLESHY, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_SCUM = mean(SCUM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(cover_distribution, width = Inf)


# Block-date averages for seasonal comparisons
cover_block_date <- cover_sitewide %>%
  filter(!is.na(algal_cover)) %>%
  group_by(site, year, date, month, plot_number) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_algal = mean(algal_cover),
    n_surveys = n_distinct(survey_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Average repeated dates within each block-month
cover_block_month <- cover_block_date %>%
  group_by(site, year, month, plot_number) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_algal = mean(mean_algal),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Monthly site-wide means ± SE across blocks
cover_month_summary <- cover_block_month %>%
  group_by(site, year, month) %>%
  summarise(
    n_blocks = n(),
    mean_algal = mean(mean_algal),
    se_algal = sd(mean_algal) / sqrt(n_blocks),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(cover_month_summary, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Full-season algal cover model
cover_model <- cover_block_month %>%
  mutate(
    site = factor(site, levels = c("big_river", "noyo")),
    year = factor(year, levels = c(2025, 2026)),
    month = factor(month),
    site_year_block = interaction(
      site, year, plot_number, drop = TRUE
    )
  )

# Additive model
cover_add <- lmer(
  mean_algal ~ site + year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block),
  data = cover_model,
  REML = FALSE
)

# Site × year interaction model
cover_int <- lmer(
  mean_algal ~ site * year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block),
  data = cover_model,
  REML = FALSE
)

# Compare models
anova(cover_add, cover_int)

# Inspect interaction model
summary(cover_int)

# Basic residual checks
plot(cover_int)
qqnorm(resid(cover_int))
qqline(resid(cover_int))
```

```{r}
# Full-season: 2026 vs 2025 within each site
cover_year_emm <- emmeans(
  cover_int,
  ~ year | site
)

summary(
  pairs(cover_year_emm, reverse = TRUE),
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
)


# July–August sensitivity analysis
cover_shared <- cover_model %>%
  filter(month %in% c("7", "8")) %>%
  droplevels()

cover_shared_add <- lmer(
  mean_algal ~ site + year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block),
  data = cover_shared,
  REML = FALSE
)

cover_shared_int <- lmer(
  mean_algal ~ site * year + month +
    (1 | site_year_block),
  data = cover_shared,
  REML = FALSE
)

# Does the interaction persist?
anova(cover_shared_add, cover_shared_int)

# Compare years within sites
summary(
  pairs(
    emmeans(cover_shared_int, ~ year | site),
    reverse = TRUE
  ),
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
cover_groups <- c(
  "CCA", "ACA", "ER", "BR",
  "turf", "FLESHY", "SCUM"
)

# 1. Keep surveys with complete cover-group measurements
cover_comm <- cover_sitewide %>%
  filter(
    if_all(all_of(cover_groups), ~ !is.na(.x))
  )

# Check how many surveys remain
cover_comm %>%
  count(site, year, name = "n_surveys") %>%
  print()


# 2. Average subplots within each block-date,
# then dates within each block-year
cover_block_year <- cover_comm %>%
  group_by(site, year, date, plot_number) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(cover_groups), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year, plot_number) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(cover_groups), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Verify independent block-year units
cover_block_year %>%
  count(site, year, name = "n_blocks") %>%
  print()


# 3. PERMANOVA and dispersion tests by site
for (site_name in c("big_river", "noyo")) {

  cat("\n========================\n")
  cat("SITE:", site_name, "\n")
  cat("========================\n")

  site_data <- cover_block_year %>%
    filter(site == site_name) %>%
    mutate(year = factor(year))

  # Community matrix
  cover_matrix <- as.matrix(
    site_data[, cover_groups]
  )

  # Hellinger transformation
  # Standardizes each block-year's cover composition
  cover_hel <- decostand(
    cover_matrix,
    method = "hellinger"
  )

  # Euclidean distances on transformed community data
  cover_dist <- dist(cover_hel)

  # PERMANOVA
  cat("\nPERMANOVA:\n")

  print(
    adonis2(
      cover_dist ~ year,
      data = site_data,
      permutations = 9999
    )
  )

  # Homogeneity of multivariate dispersion
  cover_disp <- betadisper(
    cover_dist,
    group = site_data$year
  )

  cat("\nDISPERSION TEST:\n")

  print(
    permutest(
      cover_disp,
      permutations = 9999
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# BIG RIVER: Paired benthic composition analysis
# Only blocks 1–7 represent matching locations

br_cover_paired <- cover_block_year %>%
  filter(
    site == "big_river",
    plot_number %in% 1:7
  ) %>%
  arrange(plot_number, year) %>%
  mutate(year = factor(year))

# Confirm each block has one observation per year
br_cover_paired %>%
  count(plot_number, year) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Hellinger-transformed community matrix
br_cover_matrix <- br_cover_paired %>%
  select(all_of(cover_groups)) %>%
  as.matrix()

br_cover_dist <- dist(
  vegan::decostand(
    br_cover_matrix,
    method = "hellinger"
  )
)

# PERMANOVA with permutations restricted within blocks
set.seed(123)

br_cover_permanova_paired <- vegan::adonis2(
  br_cover_dist ~ year,
  data = br_cover_paired,
  permutations = 9999,
  strata = br_cover_paired$plot_number
)

print(br_cover_permanova_paired)

# Check multivariate dispersion
br_cover_disp_paired <- vegan::betadisper(
  br_cover_dist,
  group = br_cover_paired$year
)

vegan::permutest(
  br_cover_disp_paired,
  permutations = 9999
)
```
