```{r}
fish_zone_2025 <- surveys_2025 %>%
  filter(data_type %in% c("fish_on", "fish_off")) %>%
  mutate(
    year = 2025L,
    date = as.Date(date),
    fish_location = data_type,
    plot_number = as.integer(
      str_extract(as.character(arkev_unit), "\\d+")
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    year, site, date, survey_id,
    plot_type, arkev_unit,
    plot_number, fish_location
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    fish_count = if (anyNA(count_num)) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      sum(count_num)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    area_m2 = if_else(
      fish_location == "fish_on",
      pi,
      3 * pi
    ),
    valid = !is.na(fish_count),
    fish_density = fish_count / area_m2
  )


fish_zone_both <- bind_rows(
  fish_zone_2025 %>%
    select(
      year, site, date, plot_type,
      arkev_unit, plot_number,
      fish_location, valid,
      fish_count, area_m2, fish_density
    ),

  fish_zone_2026 %>%
    mutate(
      year = 2026L,
      area_m2 = if_else(
        fish_location == "fish_on",
        pi,
        3 * pi
      ),
      fish_density = fish_count / area_m2
    ) %>%
    select(
      year, site, date, plot_type,
      arkev_unit, plot_number,
      fish_location, valid,
      fish_count, area_m2, fish_density
    )
) %>%
  filter(
    valid,
    !is.na(fish_count),
    fish_location %in% c("fish_on", "fish_off")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    month = as.integer(format(date, "%m"))
  )


fish_zone_both %>%
  group_by(site, year, fish_location) %>%
  summarise(
    n_zones = n(),
    n_blocks = n_distinct(plot_number),
    area_m2 = first(area_m2),
    mean_density = mean(fish_density),
    median_density = median(fish_density),
    pct_with_fish = 100 * mean(fish_count > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Build species counts for every valid fish survey zone
fish_keys <- c(
  "year", "site", "date", "plot_type",
  "arkev_unit", "fish_location"
)

species_codes <- sort(unique(fish_species_records$species))

fish_species_wide <- fish_species_records %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(fish_keys)), species) %>%
  summarise(
    count = sum(fish_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = count,
    values_fill = 0
  )

fish_zone_species <- fish_zone_both %>%
  mutate(
    plot_type = stringr::str_to_lower(plot_type),
    arkev_unit = stringr::str_to_upper(arkev_unit)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fish_species_wide,
    by = fish_keys,
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(species_codes), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))
  )

# Confirm that species counts still match zone totals
stopifnot(all(
  abs(
    rowSums(as.matrix(
      fish_zone_species[, species_codes]
    )) - fish_zone_species$fish_count
  ) < 1e-8
))


# Calculate species-specific mean densities
fish_species_block_date <- fish_zone_species %>%
  group_by(
    site, year, date, plot_number, fish_location
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(species_codes), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(species_codes),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "mean_count"
  )

fish_species_density <- fish_species_block_date %>%
  group_by(site, year, fish_location, species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(mean_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    area_m2 = if_else(
      fish_location == "fish_on",
      pi,
      3 * pi
    ),
    mean_density = mean_count / area_m2
  ) %>%
  select(site, year, fish_location, species, mean_density)


# Keep the six dominant species at each site
fish_top_species <- fish_species_density %>%
  group_by(site, species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_density = sum(mean_density),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  slice_max(total_density, n = 6, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(is_top = TRUE)

fish_composition <- fish_species_density %>%
  left_join(
    fish_top_species %>%
      select(site, species, is_top),
    by = c("site", "species")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = if_else(is.na(is_top), "Other", species)
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year, fish_location, group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_density = sum(mean_density),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year, fish_location) %>%
  mutate(
    relative_abundance =
      100 * mean_density / sum(mean_density)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#Plot 
make_fish_hurricane <- function(site_name) {

  plot_data <- fish_composition %>%
    filter(site == site_name)

  species_order <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(
      total = sum(mean_density),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(total)) %>%
    pull(group)

  species_order <- c(
    setdiff(species_order, "Other"),
    "Other"
  )

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      year = factor(year, levels = c(2025, 2026)),
      fish_location = factor(
        fish_location,
        levels = c("fish_on", "fish_off"),
        labels = c("Fish on", "Fish off")
      ),
      group = factor(group, levels = rev(species_order)),
      plot_abundance = if_else(
        year == "2025",
        -relative_abundance,
        relative_abundance
      ),
      label_x = if_else(
        year == "2025",
        plot_abundance - 2,
        plot_abundance + 2
      ),
      label_hjust = if_else(year == "2025", 1, 0),
      density_label = case_when(
        mean_density == 0 ~ "",
        mean_density < 0.01 ~ sprintf("%.3f", mean_density),
        TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", mean_density)
      )
    )

  site_title <- if (
    site_name == "big_river"
  ) "Big River" else "Noyo"

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = plot_abundance,
      y = group,
      fill = year
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.7,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        x = label_x,
        label = density_label,
        hjust = label_hjust
      ),
      size = 3
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ fish_location, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "2025" = "#D55E00",
        "2026" = "#0072B2"
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-100, 100, 50),
      labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%")
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-120, 120)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Fish Community —", site_title),
      x = "Relative abundance (%)",
      y = "Fish species",
      fill = "Year"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Prepare full-season fish data
fish_model_data <- fish_zone_both %>%
  mutate(
    site = factor(site, levels = c("big_river", "noyo")),
    year = factor(year, levels = c(2025, 2026)),
    month = factor(month),

    site_year_block = interaction(
      site, year, plot_number,
      drop = TRUE
    ),

    site_date = interaction(
      site, date,
      drop = TRUE
    )
  )

# Fit models separately for fish-on and fish-off

fish_nb_models <- list()

for (zone in c("fish_on", "fish_off")) {

  cat("\n========================\n")
  cat("ZONE:", zone, "\n")
  cat("========================\n")

  zone_data <- fish_model_data %>%
    filter(fish_location == zone) %>%
    droplevels()

  # Additive model
  model_add <- glmmTMB(
    fish_count ~ site + year + month +
      (1 | site_year_block) +
      (1 | site_date),
    family = nbinom2,
    data = zone_data
  )

  # Site × Year interaction
  model_int <- glmmTMB(
    fish_count ~ site * year + month +
      (1 | site_year_block) +
      (1 | site_date),
    family = nbinom2,
    data = zone_data
  )

  cat("\nINTERACTION TEST:\n")
  print(anova(model_add, model_int))

  cat("\nMODEL SUMMARY:\n")
  print(summary(model_int))

  cat("\nCONVERGENCE:\n")
  print(model_int$fit$convergence)
  print(model_int$sdr$pdHess)

  # Basic residual checks
  set.seed(123)

  res <- simulateResiduals(
    fittedModel = model_int,
    n = 500
  )

  cat("\nDISPERSION:\n")
  print(testDispersion(res))

  cat("\nZERO INFLATION:\n")
  print(testZeroInflation(res))

  fish_nb_models[[zone]] <- list(
    additive = model_add,
    interaction = model_int,
    residuals = res
  )
}
```

```{r}
for (zone in c("fish_on", "fish_off")) {

  cat("\n========================\n")
  cat("ZONE:", zone, "\n")
  cat("========================\n")

  model <- fish_nb_models[[zone]]$additive

  # Overall year comparison
  cat("\nYEAR: 2026 / 2025\n")

  print(
    summary(
      contrast(
        emmeans(model, ~ year),
        method = "revpairwise"
      ),
      type = "response",
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    )
  )

  # Overall site comparison
  cat("\nSITE: Noyo / Big River\n")

  print(
    summary(
      contrast(
        emmeans(model, ~ site),
        method = "revpairwise"
      ),
      type = "response",
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    )
  )

  # Final residual checks
  set.seed(123)

  res <- simulateResiduals(
    model,
    n = 500
  )

  cat("\nUNIFORMITY:\n")
  print(testUniformity(res))

  cat("\nOUTLIERS:\n")
  print(testOutliers(res, type = "bootstrap"))
}
```

```{r}
# Common identifiers
keys <- c("site", "year", "date", "plot_number")

# Function that automatically creates plot_number if missing
get_coverage <- function(data, group_name) {

  if (!("plot_number" %in% names(data))) {
    data <- data %>%
      mutate(
        plot_number = as.integer(
          str_extract(as.character(arkev_unit), "\\d+")
        )
      )
  }

  data %>%
    mutate(
      year = as.integer(as.character(year)),
      date = as.Date(date),
      site = str_replace_all(
        str_to_lower(str_trim(site)), " ", "_"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(site),
      !is.na(year),
      !is.na(date),
      !is.na(plot_number)
    ) %>%
    distinct(site, year, date, plot_number) %>%
    mutate(!!group_name := 1L)
}

# Combine coverage across all five communities
community_coverage <- get_coverage(
  kelp_sitewide, "kelp"
) %>%
  full_join(
    get_coverage(grazer_sitewide, "grazers"),
    by = keys
  ) %>%
  full_join(
    get_coverage(invert_sitewide, "inverts"),
    by = keys
  ) %>%
  full_join(
    get_coverage(
      cover_sitewide %>%
        filter(if_all(all_of(cover_groups), ~ !is.na(.x))),
      "cover"
    ),
    by = keys
  ) %>%
  full_join(
    get_coverage(fish_zone_both, "fish"),
    by = keys
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(kelp, grazers, inverts, cover, fish),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    ),
    n_communities = kelp + grazers + inverts +
      cover + fish
  )

# Summarize overlapping surveys
community_coverage %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_block_dates = n(),
    all_five = sum(n_communities == 5),
    four_or_more = sum(n_communities >= 4),
    three_or_more = sum(n_communities >= 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# Common identifiers
keys <- c("site", "year", "date", "plot_number")

# Standardize identifiers across all communities
prepare_integrated <- function(data) {

  data %>%
    mutate(
      site = str_replace_all(
        str_to_lower(str_trim(site)), " ", "_"
      ),
      year = as.integer(as.character(year)),
      date = as.Date(date),

      # Handles both 10A and C10A
      plot_number = as.integer(
        str_extract(as.character(arkev_unit), "\\d+")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(site),
      !is.na(year),
      !is.na(date),
      !is.na(plot_number)
    )
}

#Kelp
integrated_kelp <- kelp_richness_sitewide %>%
  prepare_integrated() %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(keys))) %>%
  summarise(
    kelp_density = mean(kelp_density),
    kelp_richness = mean(kelp_richness),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Grazers
integrated_grazers <- grazer_sitewide %>%
  prepare_integrated() %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(keys))) %>%
  summarise(
    grazer_density = mean(grazer_density),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#inverts
integrated_inverts <- invert_richness_sitewide %>%
  prepare_integrated() %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(keys))) %>%
  summarise(
    invert_density = mean(invert_density),
    invert_richness = mean(invert_richness),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Benthic cover
integrated_cover <- cover_sitewide %>%
  prepare_integrated() %>%
  filter(
    if_all(all_of(cover_groups), ~ !is.na(.x))
  ) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(keys))) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(cover_groups), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Fish (on and off separately)
integrated_fish <- fish_zone_both %>%
  prepare_integrated() %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(keys)), fish_location) %>%
  summarise(
    fish_density = mean(fish_density),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fish_richness_zone %>%
      prepare_integrated() %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(keys)), fish_location) %>%
      summarise(
        fish_richness = mean(fish_richness),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c(keys, "fish_location")
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = fish_location,
    values_from = c(fish_density, fish_richness)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    density_fish_on = fish_density_fish_on,
    density_fish_off = fish_density_fish_off,
    richness_fish_on = fish_richness_fish_on,
    richness_fish_off = fish_richness_fish_off
  )
```

```{r}
# Ecological variables
ecological_vars <- c(
  "kelp_density",
  "kelp_richness",
  "grazer_density",
  "invert_density",
  "invert_richness",
  cover_groups,
  "density_fish_on",
  "density_fish_off",
  "richness_fish_on",
  "richness_fish_off"
)

#Join all five communities
integrated_block_date <- list(
  integrated_kelp,
  integrated_grazers,
  integrated_inverts,
  integrated_cover,
  integrated_fish
) %>%
  purrr::reduce(inner_join, by = keys) %>%
  filter(
    if_all(all_of(ecological_vars), ~ !is.na(.x))
  )

integrated_block_year <- integrated_block_date %>%
  mutate(month = as.integer(format(date, "%m"))) %>%
  group_by(site, year, plot_number, month) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(ecological_vars), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, year, plot_number) %>%
  summarise(
    n_months = n(),
    across(all_of(ecological_vars), mean),
    .groups = "drop"

integrated_block_date %>%
  count(site, year, name = "n_block_dates") %>%
  print(n = Inf)

integrated_block_year %>%
  count(site, year, name = "n_blocks") %>%
  print(n = Inf)

integrated_block_year %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(ecological_vars), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))
  ) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```

```{r}
#Prepare ecological variables

density_vars <- c(
  "kelp_density",
  "grazer_density",
  "invert_density",
  "density_fish_on",
  "density_fish_off"
)

pca_data <- integrated_block_year %>%
  select(all_of(ecological_vars)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(density_vars), log1p)
  )

#PCA with standardized variables

integrated_pca <- prcomp(
  pca_data,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

# Variance explained by each axis

pca_variance <- 100 *
  integrated_pca$sdev^2 /
  sum(integrated_pca$sdev^2)

print(round(pca_variance[1:5], 1))
```

```{r}
#Extract PCA scores

)
```

```{r}
pca_scores <- bind_cols(
  integrated_block_year %>%
    select(site, year, plot_number),
  as_tibble(integrated_pca$x[, 1:2])
) %>%
  mutate(
    site = factor(
      site,
      levels = c("big_river", "noyo"),
      labels = c("Big River", "Noyo")
    ),
    year = factor(year, levels = c(2025, 2026))
  )

pca_vectors <- as.data.frame(
  integrated_pca$rotation[, 1:2]
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  mutate(
    contribution = PC1^2 + PC2^2
  ) %>%
  slice_max(contribution, n = 10)

arrow_scale <- 0.8 * min(
  diff(range(pca_scores$PC1)) /
    diff(range(pca_vectors$PC1)),
  diff(range(pca_scores$PC2)) /
    diff(range(pca_vectors$PC2))
)

pca_vectors <- pca_vectors %>%
  mutate(
    PC1 = PC1 * arrow_scale,
    PC2 = PC2 * arrow_scale
  )
```

```{r}
# Extract the 10 strongest PCA vectors
pca_vectors <- as.data.frame(
  integrated_pca$rotation[, 1:2]
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  mutate(
    contribution = PC1^2 + PC2^2
  ) %>%
  slice_max(
    contribution,
    n = 10,
    with_ties = FALSE
  )

# Scale vectors to fit the PCA scores
arrow_scale <- 0.8 * min(
  diff(range(pca_scores$PC1)) / diff(range(pca_vectors$PC1)),
  diff(range(pca_scores$PC2)) / diff(range(pca_vectors$PC2))
)

pca_vectors <- pca_vectors %>%
  mutate(
    PC1 = PC1 * arrow_scale,
    PC2 = PC2 * arrow_scale
  )

# Base PCA plot without vectors
integrated_pca_plot <- ggplot(
  pca_scores,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = site, shape = year)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey75") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey75") +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Big River" = "#D55E00",
      "Noyo" = "#0072B2"
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "2025" = 16,
      "2026" = 17
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Community Composition by Year and Site",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_variance[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_variance[2], 1), "%)"),
    color = "Site",
    shape = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Add one set of vectors to the base plot
integrated_pca_biplot <- integrated_pca_plot +
  geom_segment(
    data = pca_vectors,
    aes(
      x = 0, y = 0,
      xend = PC1, yend = PC2
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    arrow = grid::arrow(
      length = grid::unit(0.18, "cm")
    ),
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = pca_vectors,
    aes(
      x = PC1 * 1.1,
      y = PC2 * 1.1,
      label = variable
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.3,
    color = "black",
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    max.iter = 10000,
    seed = 123,
    segment.color = "grey65"
  )

print(integrated_pca_plot)
print(integrated_pca_biplot)
```

```{r}
pca_stages <- list(
  "Big River — 2025" = pca_scores %>%
    filter(site == "Big River", year == "2025"),

  "Big River — 2025 and 2026" = pca_scores %>%
    filter(site == "Big River"),

  "Big River + Noyo 2025" = pca_scores %>%
    filter(
      site == "Big River" |
        (site == "Noyo" & year == "2025")
    ),

  "Big River + Noyo — Both Years" = pca_scores
)

# Keep the same axis limits in all four plots
pca_xlim <- range(pca_scores$PC1)
pca_ylim <- range(pca_scores$PC2)

pca_xlim <- pca_xlim + c(-1, 1) * diff(pca_xlim) * 0.08
pca_ylim <- pca_ylim + c(-1, 1) * diff(pca_ylim) * 0.08

pca_step_plots <- lapply(
  names(pca_stages),
  function(stage_name) {

    ggplot(
      pca_stages[[stage_name]],
      aes(
        x = PC1,
        y = PC2,
        color = site,
        shape = year
      )
    ) +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        color = "grey80"
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = 0,
        color = "grey80"
      ) +
      geom_point(
        size = 3.5,
        alpha = 0.9
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "Big River" = "#D55E00",
          "Noyo" = "#0072B2"
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_shape_manual(
        values = c(
          "2025" = 16,
          "2026" = 17
        ),
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(
        xlim = pca_xlim,
        ylim = pca_ylim
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Community Composition by Year and Site",
        x = paste0(
          "PC1 (", round(pca_variance[1], 1), "%)"
        ),
        y = paste0(
          "PC2 (", round(pca_variance[2], 1), "%)"
        ),
        color = "Site",
        shape = "Year"
      ) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
  }
)

names(pca_step_plots) <- names(pca_stages)

for (p in pca_step_plots) {
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
#weighted variables
```

```{r}
      ) %>%
      distinct(plot_number, month, date) %>%
      count(plot_number, month, name = "n_dates") %>%
      mutate(source = source_name)
  }
) %>%
  complete(
    plot_number = 1:10,
    month = c(7L, 8L),
    source = names(noyo_sources),
    fill = list(n_dates = 0L)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = source,
    values_from = n_dates
  ) %>%
  arrange(plot_number, month)

noyo_month_audit %>%
  filter(matched == 0) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```



```{r}
noyo_shared_month <- integrated_block_date %>%
  filter(
    site == "noyo",
    as.integer(format(date, "%m")) %in% c(7, 8)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    month = as.integer(format(date, "%m"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, plot_number, month) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(ecological_vars), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Identify the incomplete block-year
noyo_shared_month %>%
  count(year, plot_number, name = "n_months") %>%
  filter(n_months < 2) %>%
  print()

# Retain only block-years with both months
noyo_shared <- noyo_shared_month %>%
  group_by(year, plot_number) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(month) == 2) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(ecological_vars), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = factor(year))

print(noyo_shared %>% count(year))

# Apply the same transformation and scaling as the PCA
noyo_shared_scaled <- noyo_shared %>%
  select(all_of(ecological_vars)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(density_vars), log1p)
  ) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  scale(
    center = integrated_pca$center,
    scale = integrated_pca$scale
  )

# Original standardized analysis
noyo_shared_dist <- dist(noyo_shared_scaled)

set.seed(123)

noyo_shared_permanova <- vegan::adonis2(
  noyo_shared_dist ~ year,
  data = noyo_shared,
  permutations = 9999
)

print(noyo_shared_permanova)

# Equal-community-weighted analysis
noyo_shared_weighted_data <- sweep(
  noyo_shared_scaled,
  2,
  community_weights[colnames(noyo_shared_scaled)],
  "*"
)

noyo_shared_weighted_dist <- dist(
  noyo_shared_weighted_data
)

set.seed(123)

noyo_shared_weighted_permanova <- vegan::adonis2(
  noyo_shared_weighted_dist ~ year,
  data = noyo_shared,
  permutations = 9999
)

print(noyo_shared_weighted_permanova)

# Dispersion diagnostics
set.seed(123)

vegan::permutest(
  vegan::betadisper(
    noyo_shared_dist,
    noyo_shared$year
  ),
  permutations = 9999
)

set.seed(123)

vegan::permutest(
  vegan::betadisper(
    noyo_shared_weighted_dist,
    noyo_shared$year
  ),
  permutations = 9999
)
```


#UPC
```{r}
upc_26 = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VPHlUVfLAlGB0oEj0cs6hPSbI45WuIqCXnCsIu7DyPo/edit?gid=0#gid=0')
print(upc_26)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

upc_clean <- upc_26 %>%
  mutate(
    code = map_chr(code, ~ as.character(.x[[1]])),
    relief_value = if_else(
      data_type == "Relief",
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(code)),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

library(tidyverse)

upc_plot <- upc_clean %>%
  group_by(site, plot, data_type, code) %>%
  summarise(
    total_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, plot, data_type) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * total_count / sum(total_count)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
upc_plot_complete <- upc_plot %>%
  group_by(data_type) %>%
  complete(
    nesting(site, plot),
    code,
    fill = list(
      total_count = 0,
      percent = 0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

upc_site <- upc_plot_complete %>%
  group_by(site, data_type, code) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(percent),
    sd_percent = sd(percent),
    n_plots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
upc_site %>%
  select(site, data_type, code, site_percent) %>%
  arrange(site, data_type, desc(site_percent)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```
